name: Smash and Grab
note: R8.22, Module R2 SSD p.73. A light cruiser (owner's call on the line) and the Battle Raider's smaller sibling: identical shields at 30/30/24/24/24/30, the same five option mounts, the same eight phasers in the same arcs, two years earlier and 15 points cheaper. Where it differs is below decks - one bridge box to the BR's two, 10+10 warp against 12+12, three impulse against four, and no lab advantage. ITS THREE CENTERLINE MOUNTS ARE ONE RUN (owner, 2026-10-20), so a two-mount weapon seats on A+B or B+C and never A+C. The sheet says nothing either way, and that silence is the point: the DBR prints 'MOUNTS A, B, AND C ARE NOT CENTERLINE ADJACENT' in this very box because it is the exception, so a sheet that stays quiet is describing the normal case. NOT NIMBLE, also by the owner's ruling on silence - the DBR prints 'NIMBLE SHIP' and the BR prints 'IT IS NOT NIMBLE', and this one prints neither. Its Y175 note reads 'ARE DOUBLED', the older wording for the +1 every Orion rack gains. Unlike the BCH and OK6 it CAN land on planets, by aerodynamic, gravity or powered systems, with the crash landing bonus (P2.43). NOT MODELLED: the Y170 plasma carronade and sabot refit (Module R10), the MINELAYER REFIT (R8.R1), and (R8.R3) for option mount firing arcs.
